description: A sequencer that grows a tree and reads a run of neighbouring branches as a sequence, five voltages coming off every step

params.text: Sets how much the angle of a new branch varies when a branch grows on alone
Sets how much the angles vary when a branch splits into several
Sets how strongly branches are pulled towards the sun as they grow
Sets how many branches a split makes, 1 to 4
Sets how many steps the sequence runs before it returns to its start, 1 to 64
Attenuates the LENGTH input before it is added to the LENGTH knob
Moves the starting point of the run through the tree, so a different set of branches is read
Attenuates the OFFSET input before it is added to the OFFSET knob
Sets how much of the wind pushing the branch being read is added to that branch's five voltages
Attenuates the WIND input before it is added to the WIND knob

inputs.text: A rising edge past 1V throws the tree away and starts a new one from a single branch
A rising edge past 1V sends the sequence back to its first step
A rising edge past 1V moves the sequence on one step and writes new voltages to the five outputs
Shifts the sequence length, 10V covering the whole of the 1 to 64 range at full attenuation; the total is held inside it
Moves the starting point of the run through the tree, 10V covering the whole tree at full attenuation
Shifts how much wind is added, 10V covering the whole of the WIND knob's travel at full attenuation; the total is held between none of it and all of it

outputs.text: One of the five voltages held by the branch the sequence is reading, -5V to +5V, changing only when a clock arrives

notes: the five outputs change only when a rising edge arrives at CLOCK; with no clock patched the tree grows and nothing comes out.
the tree keeps growing while the patch runs, up to 1024 branches, so the same OFFSET setting reaches different branches as it fills out.
the wind blows on its own and is strongest on the small branches, so a run taken from further out changes more from step to step.
menu: Branch mutation chance — sets the chance that the branch being read is given new random values each time the sequence reaches it
